message.name: TRITRI_TRACK
message.description: C-UAS track identity (correlation spine). Single COP type for air and apps.
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX epoch, microseconds UTC).
Time the object was first detected (UNIX epoch, microseconds UTC).
Globally-unique track identifier (UUID). Stable across the whole chain.
Associated target set identifier, if any. 0 = none.
Confidence of identification [0.0-1.0]. NaN if not provided.
Identifier of the ATR model/version that produced atr_confidence_pct. 0 = unspecified.
System ID of the platform that originated/owns this track.
Sensor/method underlying the current identification.
Method by which identification was reached.
Positive identification status (descriptive).
Classification (what it is).
Force affiliation.
STANAG/APP-6 standard identity.
STANAG/APP-6 battle dimension / environment.
ATR model confidence [0-100]. 255 = N/A.
OPTIONAL advisory display tier. Not for automated ROE.
Reality vs exercise vs simulation (SIDC digit 3).

message.name: TRITRI_TARGET
message.description: C-UAS live air kinematics plus track_uid for correlation. Single COP type for air and apps.
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX epoch, microseconds UTC).
Timestamp when the target fix was valid (UNIX epoch, microseconds UTC).
Track UID correlating to TRITRI_TRACK. All-zero if unknown.
Short human-readable callsign (null-terminated).
Unique target identifier generated by the source system.
Parent target set identifier. 0 = none.
Target warning and status flags.
Target latitude, WGS84. INT32_MAX if unknown.
Target longitude, WGS84. INT32_MAX if unknown.
Target altitude, MSL. NaN if unknown.
Velocity north (NED). NaN if unknown.
Velocity east (NED). NaN if unknown.
Velocity down (NED). NaN if unknown.
Position covariance, north axis (m^2). NaN if unknown.
Position covariance, east axis (m^2). NaN if unknown.
Position covariance, down axis (m^2). NaN if unknown.
Velocity covariance, north axis (m^2/s^2). NaN if unknown.
Velocity covariance, east axis (m^2/s^2). NaN if unknown.
Velocity covariance, down axis (m^2/s^2). NaN if unknown.
Classification or detection confidence scaled 0-10000.
Target classification.
Primary operating domain.
Force affiliation.
Primary sensor source.
Target-location-error category label. 0 if unset.
No-strike / restricted / NFA flags. 0 if none.
